items.title: 56679_Arthur Briggs oral history interview
items.q: Noble asked me to get musicians for him and to form an orchestra for him.

ctx.x: You were talking about Jean Brashear.

Hugues financed the -- as I said, he came to the Ambassadors, and he wanted, he asked me, "Why don't you play like Mezzrow," so I told him to see Noble and ask Noble that question. So, he went and asked Noble. He said, "Why don't you all play like Mezzrow?" So, Sissle, he said, "Why don't you go and see, if you want to hear someone play like Mezzrow, go and listen to Mezzrow yourself." (Laughter).
Okay, I guess we're all set. That seems to be coming through fine.
